questions.question_markdown:
19. 已知圆 $O: x^2 + y^2 = 9$ 与 $x$ 轴的正半轴交于点 $P$，以 $P$ 为圆心，半径为 $r$ 的圆与圆 $O$ 相交于 $M, N$ 两点。
(1) 过点 $A(3,1)$ 的直线与圆 $O$ 相切，求切线方程；
(2) $D$ 为圆 $O$ 上的动点（异于点 $P$），若线段 $PD$ 上有一点 $E$，满足 $\overrightarrow{PE} = 2\overrightarrow{ED}$，求点 $E$ 的轨迹方程；
(3) 若 $Q$ 是圆 $O$ 上任意一点（不与 $M, N$ 重合），直线 $QM, QN$ 分别与 $x$ 轴交于点 $K$ 和 $T$，则 $|OK| \cdot |OT|$ 是否为定值？若是，求出该定值；若不是，请说明理由。

handwritten_answer.evidence_note: Color context C001 and answer_detail_01 show dark-red retained handwriting only for part (3), matching the draft line by line: setup M(x0,y0), Q(x1,y1), (y1 != +/-y0), N(x0,-y0), x0^2+y0^2=9 and x1^2+y1^2=9, lines l_QM and l_QN with fractions (y0-y1)/(x0-x1) and (-y0-y1)/(x0-x1), then x_K=(x1y0-x0y1)/(y0-y1) and x_T=(x1y0+x0y1)/(y0+y1), then |OK|.|OT|=|x_K.x_T| = |(x1^2 y0^2 - x0^2 y1^2)/(y0^2 - y1^2)| = |((9-y1^2)y0^2-(9-y0^2)y1^2)/(y0^2-y1^2)| = 9; parts (1) and (2) have no handwriting, consistent with the draft's unrecognized markers. A faint short dash before the x_T numerator is inconclusive (pen stop vs minus) and the following product step uses the plus form, so no patch is made.
